CLAUDE FABLE 5 UPDATE WILL REPLACE MANUAL TRADERS

New update will change everything for devs.

My current bot i made with Claude is still running.

+5,474.62 PnL in a few days.
(started with $100 publicly) 

And it never predicted a single candle to get there.

One dead simple rule: YES + NO < $1.

On a BTC Up/Down market, YES and NO must add up to exactly $1 at resolution.

One side ends at a dollar. 
The other ends at zero.

But the orderbook is messy and both sides trade like strangers.

So for a few seconds YES sits at 47 cents while NO sits at 49.

That's 96 cents to own BOTH sides of a market that pays a guaranteed dollar.

4 cents locked, and it does not care where Bitcoin goes.

The whole game is speed. 

Gaps close in seconds, fees eat the thin ones, and you need both legs filled before it's gone.

Here's where a better model actually changes things for us builders:

It writes tighter execution code.

Meaning less lag between spotting the gap and firing both legs. 

It also catches edge cases a dumber model misses (phantom fills, partial legs, the stuff that turns free money into a loss ).

And it backtests and debugs way faster.

Better model will open the next door for evey arb bot developer.

The gap between button-clickers and builders was already wide.

I guess tomorrow it turns into a smth different.

Check my last articles if you're into arb.

Made them free so our community of builders grow.

Peace.
